description: This Kotlin source file defines the GatewayEventHandler class responsible for managing wake words synchronization with a gateway service, including scheduling updates, refreshing wake words from the gateway, and handling wake word change events.

classes.name: GatewayEventHandler
classes.description: Class responsible for handling voice wake word events and synchronization with a gateway session.

methods.name: applyWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Sets wake words locally and temporarily suppresses synchronization to the gateway.

methods.name: scheduleWakeWordsSyncIfNeeded
methods.description: Schedules synchronization of wake words to the gateway if conditions permit.

methods.name: refreshWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Retrieves wake words from the gateway and applies them locally.

methods.name: handleVoiceWakeChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON payloads indicating wake word changes and updates the local state.
